summary: Updated roundcubemail package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
Fix open redirect via IMAP error recovery on attachment get, reported by
Santhoshkumar S.
Fix so Received: header includes only trusted hostname and forwarded IP
from a trusted proxy, reported by Squirt1e, Atum, N0b0dy, Gh0u1L5.
Fix bug where some managesieve destructive actions could have been
triggered cross-site via GET, reported by Squirt1e, Atum, N0b0dy,
Gh0u1L5.
Fix Sieve script injection via a rule operator, reported by Squirt1e,
Atum, N0b0dy, Gh0u1L5.
Fix Sieve script injection via set/include modifiers, reported by
Squirt1e, Atum, N0b0dy, Gh0u1L5.
Fix bug where resolve_url() ignored trusted host setting, reported by
Squirt1e, Atum, N0b0dy, Gh0u1L5.
Fix mail header injection via a MDN subject, reported by Squirt1e, Atum,
N0b0dy, Gh0u1L5
Fix HTTP request injection via the spellcheck ATD backend, reported by
Squirt1e, Atum, N0b0dy, Gh0u1L5.
Fix IMAP command injection via CRLF in _uid parameter with
messages_cache enabled, reported by dexx-tech.
Fix SSRF in CSS proxy via incomplete is_local_url() nip.io/sslip.io
bypass, reported by blacksw0rd.
Fix CSRF validation bypass for file-only POST requests, reported by
skad00sh.
Fix disabled_actions restriction bypass by writing '_' instead of '-' in
the action name, reported by skad00sh.
Fix CSRF validation bypass for mail purge/expunge commands, reported by
threalwinky.
Fix passing potentally unsafe attachment content into ImageMagick on
image type conversion, reported by José Luis Sánchez Pérez -
Cybersecurity Blue & Red Team.
Fix Unbounded CPU loop/DoS in rcube_session::unserialize() via a
negative length token, reported by Guang.
Fix SSRF filter (is_local_url()) bypass via 6to4 (2002::/16) addresses,
reported by wyx98765.
Fix so IMAP host input is validated more strictly, reported by Mohamed
Elgzouli.
